nodes.name: Electrodeposition of Ni-Fe catalyst
nodes.procedure: Catalyst layers, ~1.8 nm thick, were electrodeposited from FeSO4 and NiSO4 solutions using the procedure described previously[23] except with a shorter deposition time of 20 s; this prevented the formation of metallic Ni and Fe byproducts that were detected in thicker films (see Supporting Information S1 for details).

nodes.name: Sputter deposition and electrochemical oxidation
nodes.procedure: For the complementary EXAFS characterization of the catalyst containing 25% Fe, sputter deposition was used instead of electrodeposition to create ~2 nm thick metallic film, which was subsequently oxidized in 0.1 M KOH by cycling the potential between 0.92 and 1.62 V for ~17 h at a sweep rate of 10 mV/s. After this treatment no metallic Fe or Ni was detected, and the thickness of the oxidized film (~10 nm, estimated using the density of the Ni(II)/Fe(III) layered double hydroxide structure[31] at low potential) was sufficient for conventional EXAFS measurements.

nodes.description: OER activity measurements of mixed Ni-Fe catalysts as function of Fe content in 0.1 M KOH
nodes.source_text: Figure 1 shows that the addition of Fe to NiOOH results in up to 500-fold higher OER current density compared to pure Ni and Fe oxyhydroxide films (see Supporting Information S6 for details of OER activity measurements). A plateau in activity is reached at ∼25% Fe content.

nodes.characterization_summary: Fe^{3+} in Ni_{1-x}Fe_xOOH occupies octahedral sites with unusually short Fe-O bond distances induced by edge-sharing with surrounding [NiO_6] octahedra; pure FeOOH resembles γ-FeOOH structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Operando X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) using high energy resolution fluorescence detection (HERFD) reveals that Fe^{3+} in Ni_{1-x}Fe_xOOH occupies octahedral sites with unusually short Fe-O bond distances, induced by edge-sharing with surrounding [NiO_6] octahedra.

nodes.characterization_summary: For 75% Ni/25% Fe catalyst at 1.62 V: Fe-O distance 1.90±0.02 Å (CN 5.4±0.9), Ni-O distance 1.89±0.02 Å (CN 6.1±0.9), confirming bond contraction and edge-sharing structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: EXAFS confirms that the Fe-O and Ni-O bond lengths contract from 2.01 and 2.06Å at 1.12V to 1.90 and 1.89Å at 1.92V, respectively (Figure 2c, Table 1).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge shows oxidation from α-Ni(OH)_2 (Ni-O 2.05 Å) at low potentials to γ-NiOOH (Ni-O 1.88 Å, Ni^{3+/4+}) at high potentials with characteristic spectral shifts.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ni K-edge spectra exhibit shifts of the structure-sensitive EXAFS dips and peaks to higher energy, indicating significant bond contraction.
